blocks.x: There is a plain version of rag & enterprise knowledge systems: Answers with citations, not vibes — permission-aware retrieval over your regulated document estate. We run it with named gates, signed baselines and a weekly evidence cadence — the details are below, in the order they happen.

The workhorse of enterprise GenAI is retrieval-augmented generation done properly: hybrid lexical-plus-semantic search, structure-aware chunking for contracts, filings, SOPs and clinical protocols, permission propagation from the source system, and reranking that respects both relevance and freshness. We build retrieval platforms where every answer carries citations back to the source document and paragraph.

The hard parts are organizational as much as technical: document estates are duplicated, stale and inconsistently access-controlled. Our delivery includes a knowledge inventory and remediation plan, connector framework for SharePoint, Confluence, DMS and file shares, and freshness SLAs so the corpus does not rot — the failure mode that kills user trust in month three.

Programs of RAG & Enterprise Knowledge Systems run in Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Public Sector & Government — always against one named number, always with the baseline signed first.
What ships, in the order it ships:

items: Corpus engineering
knowledge inventory, deduplication, versioning strategy and freshness SLAs
Hybrid retrieval stack
BM25 + dense embeddings + reranking, tuned per document genre
Permission-aware serving
ACL propagation so answers respect source-system entitlements
Citation & provenance
paragraph-level citations with answer-grounding verification
Connector framework
certified connectors for SharePoint, Confluence, S3, DMS and legacy stores
